sentences.en: Why didn't you tell us you were allergic to peanuts?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不告诉我们你对花生过敏？

sentences.en: I am allergic to aspirin, penicillin, and sulfa drugs.
sentences.zh: 我对阿司匹林、青霉素和磺胺类药物过敏。

sentences.en: Even though she's allergic, I gave an egg to the child.
sentences.zh: 虽然她过敏，我还是给了孩子一个鸡蛋。

senses.zh: 过敏的,过敏症的,对…极讨厌的
